svg.title: P3 Dreg per curve and presentation family, n=131
svg.text: P3 ECC2K-130 analogue, n = 131: Dreg per curve, by presentation family (E0 ringed)

Point = mean over attempts of the per-attempt minimum Dreg over a curve's presentations in that family (recorded `dreg`; hollow triangle = bound, Dreg > dmax). x = curve index, 0 = E0; bands = Frobenius orbits.
Each family drawn at a small vertical offset for legibility (the value is the point's centre line). Grey band in a panel: range of the random-b null curves' mean Dreg, arm `null`, when measured.
random V (main): 263/263 curves | standard V: 88/263 curves | b-adapted: 263/263 curves | b-sparse: pending | nbadapt (dense-b control): pending
E0 mean Dreg: main 6.00, stdv 6.00, badapt 6.00
random V (main): 263/263 curves | standard V: 88/263 curves | b-adapted: 14/263 curves | b-sparse: pending | nbadapt (dense-b control): pending
random V (main): 7/263 curves | standard V: 88/263 curves | b-adapted: pending | b-sparse: pending | nbadapt (dense-b control): pending
random V (main): pending | standard V: 79/263 curves | b-adapted: pending | b-sparse: pending | nbadapt (dense-b control): pending
null curves: not measured in this cell

Counted metrics (dreg, outcome) are exact; presentations: stdv = standard V in several moduli, badapt = V = span(1,g,..,g^(k-1)) with g adapted to b (E0 borrows the floor curves' moduli), bsparse/nbadapt as in PROTOCOL section 4.
Source data: p3_dreg_n131.data.tsv (pooled recorded rows of p3_ecc2k130/full). A series with no row in a cell is shown as pending; bounds are never plotted as values.
